curve_source: Published PFS and OS Kaplan-Meier curves and numbers at risk from Boyer et al. (2021), Pembrolizumab Plus Ipilimumab or Placebo for Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer With PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score >=50%.
coordinate_format: Two headerless columns: time in months, survival probability
model: Two-component bivariate lognormal with one shared component label per patient
fitting_target: Joint PFS/OS marginal-curve calibration; not a likelihood from paired patient data
initialization_role: Earlier independent-margin and OS-locked numerical fits supply starting points only; only rho=0.5 rows are used
reference_role: Full-precision selected regularized parameters, used only for post-fit comparison; never optimizer starts
locked_configuration_policy: New fits never overwrite the simulation DGM configuration
